title: TypeError: transfer_to_agent() got an unexpected keyword argument 'parameters'
body:
```bash
 File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/google/adk/flows/llm_flows/base_llm_flow.py", line 417, in _postprocess_handle_function_calls_async
    if function_response_event := await functions.handle_function_calls_async(
                                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/google/adk/flows/llm_flows/functions.py", line 165, in handle_function_calls_async
    function_response = await __call_tool_async(
                        ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/google/adk/flows/llm_flows/functions.py", line 430, in __call_tool_async
    return await tool.run_async(args=args, tool_context=tool_context)
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
  File "/.venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/google/adk/tools/function_tool.py", line 82, in run_async
    return self.func(**args_to_call) or {}
           ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
TypeError: transfer_to_agent() got an unexpected keyword argument 'parameters'
```

I'm getting an error like this in a rare case when calling a subagent (about 1 out of 20 times).

I've only modified the tool and sub-agent configuration, so I don't think there's anything I need to change. How do I fix this? thanks.

linked_prs.title: Fix: Handle unexpected 'parameters' argument in FunctionTool.run_async
linked_prs.body:
The LLM occasionally includes an unexpected 'parameters' argument when calling tools, specifically observed with 'transfer_to_agent'. This change makes FunctionTool.run_async more robust by filtering arguments against the function signature before invocation.

This resolves issue #1637.

This is generated by Jules Agent.
